name: Morning Content Creator
description: Fresh morning energy channeled into content creation

flow.description: Search for trending topics, gather inspiring content, and collect ideas for the requested content. Focus on creating original content based on the user's specific request rather than just finding existing material.
Create the actual content requested by the user. Generate well-written, engaging content and save it to an appropriate file format (markdown, text, or HTML).

Enhance the content with visual suggestions, formatting improvements, and design recommendations. Provide guidance on images, layout, and visual appeal since direct image generation requires external tools.
Prepare the content for publishing by creating platform-specific versions, suggesting distribution strategies, and providing guidance for sharing across different channels.

low-energy.description: Streamlined version for lower energy days
